# E27 build plan

For independent plan review before implementation. The design stays frozen. Four assignments in `tasks.json` reserve only section 13 paths. No coder is dispatched and no implementation gate is claimed by this planning run.

At inspection, `hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, `authoring/kitmap/`, `contracts/api/` and the non-pharmacy runtime configuration are absent. The root project and `scripts/validate_contracts.py` belong to the pharmacy engine. Package schemas, seven-row examples, the 119-condition inventory and saved CliFF extracts already exist. Reuse them; do not recreate the source collection. `docs/requests/E27.md` is absent. This run can edit only `docs/build/E27/`, so the coordinator must file the Requests below before dispatch. A proposal here is not a filed or accepted request.

## Build order and connections

| Task | Concern and owned roots | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | Deterministic kit-map backend and its tests: the five allowed portions of `hub/src/crew_health/kitmap/`, `hub/tests/kitmap/` | E01 kernel, generated contracts and testing boundary; C1/C2/C3 for affected bindings |
| T2 | Source-backed authoring and deterministic configuration: `authoring/kitmap/`, `config/kit-map.json` | Start beside T1 using existing saved sources; E32 supplies its separate authored input; independent checking precedes content acceptance |
| T3 | Crew kit-map feature and browser tests: `ui/crew/src/features/kitmap/` | Start beside T1/T2 against generated examples; final browser gates require their real outputs, E03 shell and C4/C5 |
| T4 | E27 verification evidence, including the venue protocol, collection and analysis: section 13 study files, `eval/results/venue-study.json`, `eval/scenarios/e27/` | Acceptance joins T1/T2/T3 and actual scenario providers; methodology preparation may start early without collecting volunteers |

JSON dependencies describe implementation starts. T3 has no backend implementation dependency for component work; its final gates wait for the integrated hub. T4 depends on all three implementation tasks for real-stack acceptance. Its preparatory protocol work does not require a running hub. Return defects to the owning task; nobody edits another task's files.

E27-guidance is an earlier, separately greenlit deliverable required by SYSTEM sections 5.12, 8.2 and 9. The frozen E27 ownership list omits its paths. C1 is a dispatch blocker for that deliverable, not permission to hide it in `kitmap` or add unowned paths to this manifest. Pure kit-map and authoring work may proceed when their declared inputs exist. Full E27 cannot be greenlit without guidance.

T1 supplies the pure gate and capability calculation. E05 owns request/gap persistence, authorization and workflow. E28 supplies `PlanColumnsPort`; E32 implements E27's `CoverPlanningPort` and owns supply content. Both consume the same `KitMapContext` after C3 settles its missing types. E01 owns snapshots, validated release lifecycle and composition. T3 draws returned marks, counts and rendered text. T4 drives the actual HTTP/UI boundary and publishes evidence through E21's existing harness. Production never binds a kernel test fake.

Ownership checks covered every current `docs/build/*/tasks.json` and every design's section 13. Other plans are arriving concurrently, so repeat the check before dispatch. E32 owns the four supply keys' authored meaning, not writes to E27's generated file. E03 owns shell, routing, design components and copy. E21 owns runner, shared scenario registry, demo fixture and result panel. None is assigned here (`docs/tdd/E27.md:794`, `docs/tdd/E32.md:857`, `docs/SYSTEM.md:141`).

No mocks, dependency overrides, direct SQL seeding or fake services inside the hub. Kernel fakes are for component tests. Only documented external model/device/link fakes, explicit demo profiles or absent optional processes are allowed. Missing providers fail acceptance; they never cause skip, xfail or a reduced positive assertion.

Missing pinned data is typed failure, never active-version substitution. Parse before activation through C2's accepted lifecycle. |

Match sequence/environment/release, reject late responses, label retained views stale or show skeleton. Refetch/discard bounds are registered operational settings, not code defaults. |

## Gates and hand-in

Exact future commands are in `tasks.json`. Missing projects, commands, positive scenarios or shared requests block their gates. T1/T4 instrument only kitmap domain/application; the shared coverage gate must inspect covered versus total branches for every file, rather than accept a combined statement/branch percentage. T4 additionally runs the full hub suite, hub corpus/trace/safety/mutation checks and E21 scan/report. T3 runs strict types, lint, unit tests and real browser tests. Stub CI covers software clauses, including adversarial D30; stopped mode selects independent journeys; live/reference execution covers its applicable clauses and actual venue evidence. E21 must retain incompatible source-derived clauses as not_selected in the full denominator. Missing providers and executed failures are never mode exclusions. Rerun full suites after bug fixes. Local success, independent build review and green CI are all required; actual study/reference runs remain separate evidence.

Planning checks passed for four tasks and 20 disjoint ownership entries: JSON structure, dependency DAG, existing read paths, frozen section 13 allocation, named API operations, all design test IDs/scenarios, gate bypasses and forbidden dash forms. Cross-plan comparison included 30 other current manifests. No implementation, hardware, clinical, CI or independent-review result is claimed. The frozen design was not edited or rerun through a design-revision loop.
